name: Relatives' Visa (spouse/life partner and family)

requirement_groups.name: Spouse or life partner of a South African citizen or PR holder

requirements.blocker_text: Requires marriage or a genuine, documented life-partnership relationship with a South African citizen or permanent resident.

requirement_groups.name: Other close relatives (first vertical step of kinship)

requirements.blocker_text: Covers relatives within the first vertical step of kinship of a South African citizen or permanent resident -- broadly parents, children, and (for the permanent-residence version of this category specifically) siblings, with the exact qualifying relationships varying by category.

evidence_required.document: Marriage certificate or documented proof of a genuine life partnership
Sponsor's South African ID or permanent residence permit
Police clearance, medical and radiology reports

outcome.duration_length: up to 3 years, renewable, tied to the sponsoring relationship

sources.title: Eisenberg & Associates -- Permanent Residence Permit South Africa, describing the spouse/life-partner and relatives permanent-residence categories

notes: STATUS: DRAFT. HONEST SOURCING GAP: no direct fetch of a dha.gov.za page was achieved for the temporary Relatives' Visa specifically in this research pass -- the source used describes the permanent-residence version of this category (Section 27(g)) in more detail than the temporary visa itself, and the temporary-visa figures here are extrapolated with lower confidence. work_rights is 'restricted' since spousal Relatives' Visa holders typically need a separate endorsement or work-visa conversion to be employed, rather than automatic full work rights -- a structurally stricter position than several other countries' spouse-of-citizen routes documented elsewhere in this dataset. citizenship_after_months (60) reflects the general 5-years-on-PR naturalisation track, and pr_after_months (24) is an estimate pending confirmation of the exact relationship-duration threshold for the spousal permanent-residence category specifically -- see za_permanent_residence for the fuller Section 27(g)/spousal detail.
